---
title: Research Wiki
---

A shared notebook for hypotheses, experiments, and academic literature.

::: {#key-ideas .callout-note title="Key ideas"}
- This wiki indexes two research topics: behavioral network optimization and
  reinforcement learning under partial observability.
:::

## Research topics

- [Behavioral network optimization](behavioral-network-optimization.qmd) --- how
  to fit a play policy and combine work and play trajectories to estimate a
  network's gradient.
- [Reinforcement learning under partial observability](pomdp-rl.qmd) ---
  how agents represent sensory input for decisions, and how learning a prior
  over those representations might guide attention.
